description: EmbeddingGemma 2 740m audio and combined-input vectors from Google's litert-lm 0.19.0 wheel (PyPI), its own native library over the LiteRT-LM C API, CPU. Clips: example/assets/eg2_audio (generate_eg2_audio_clips.py, eSpeak NG 1.52.0 + FFmpeg 9.0.2); images: example/assets/eg2_vision. Written by integration_test/tools/eg2_audio_golden.py. Vectors are base64 little-endian float32.
